title: NZ MBIE Determination 2025/061 (comparative): refused CCC and certificate of acceptance for a lean-to
jurisdiction: New Zealand (Building Act 2004); Nelson City Council; comparative only, not Alberta
code_edition: NZ Building Code (Schedule 1 of the Building Regulations 1992) as cited; Building Act ss 95A and 99A
source_url_note: Building CodeHub resource page for the same MBIE determination (Information provider: MBIE); the building.govt.nz determination page is WAF-blocked for this worker.

facts.text: The determination reviews the refusal of a code compliance certificate for alterations to a house and the refusal of a certificate of acceptance for a lean-to.
The authority granted building consent on 27 May 2022 for alterations to an existing two-storey dwelling with an attached garage.
The code compliance certificate was refused on 31 May 2024 and the certificate of acceptance on 23 December 2024.
Figure 1 shows the lean-to during construction, as at 11 January 2023.
The owners contend that the refusal reasons were not specific enough for the statutory test.
